thread:
elaine_cs: Quick heads up — since ~03:40 PT we're seeing a delivery queue backlog impacting new-tenant onboarding tasks (webhook delivery + user provisioning). Customers may see delayed provisioning and some webhook 504s. Logging + triage in progress.

ben_infra: digging in now. seeing SQS inflight spike >10k and our worker autoscaler didn’t burst as expected. looking at throttling and IAM errors.

liam_eng: tagged. can you paste one failing message id and a repro curl for webhook timeouts?

ben_infra: example id msg-20260321-9fc3a. stacktrace link: https://internal/logs/12345 (redacted). repro: ```curl -v 'https://webhook.example/tenant/PROV' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' --connect-timeout 2```

deploy-bot: @channel Incident created: INC-20260321-01 — Delivery queue backlog. Severity: P2. Bridge: https://bridge/INC-20260321-01

elaine_cs: sketched a customer-facing status below — please review and we can reuse for all impacted tenants. want to send within the next 30m once we have ETA.

marta_support: paste the template and I’ll start triaging accounts by priority (trial > paid > enterprise).

elaine_cs: template:
```
Hi <customer> — we’re investigating onboarding delays affecting tenant creation between 03:40–04:10 PT. Your provisioning may be delayed; we’re working to clear the backlog and will update with an ETA. No action needed on your side. We’ll follow up by EOD with root cause and remediation.
```

nisha_pm: recommend we offer 1-day invoice credit for trials and 5% credit for paid accounts impacted >1 hour. Approve?

liam_eng: infra estimates clearing the backlog in ~20–30m once workers scale. plan: increase worker target and backfill. I can run the scaling routine now.

ben_infra: executing scale — bumping desired to 800 workers, draining long-running jobs first. posting progress updates here.

marta_support: confirming impacted account list now; uploading CSV to drive: https://drive/placeholder. will DM sensitive account list to CS leads.

elaine_cs: once infra confirms inflight <500, I’ll send the customer note. @nisha_pm confirm credit policy so we can include numbers in outbound.

nisha_pm: confirm 1-day trial credit / 5% paid. cc finance for manual adjustments.

ben_infra: update — workers scaling, inflight down to 3.2k. ETA ~18m to clear backlog.

elaine_cs: thanks — scheduling outbound at +30m. will tag affected customers and follow w/ full RCA + credit mechanics after closure. :thumbsup:

liam_eng: post-mortem owners proposed: comms = @elaine_cs, mitigation/actions = @ben_infra, RCA = @liam_eng.

elaine_cs: agreed. I’ll draft the RCA once the queue clears and coordinate customer follow-ups.

marta_support: putting together priority outreach list and template variants for enterprise customers (more detail + SLA note). will share in 10m.
